descriptions.agent: Sentinel-RX: detectors + LLM hypothesis loop + safety layer + verification gate
descriptions.do_nothing: never acts; claims recovery iff observable health >= 0.9 (sanity floor)
descriptions.random: 1-3 random allowlisted actions per iteration; claims recovery when health >= 0.9
descriptions.single_shot: one LLM call on a telemetry summary, acts, no loop, no verification
descriptions.llm_only: the full loop but WITHOUT detectors (raw telemetry summary in the prompt)
descriptions.no_verify: agent minus the verification gate (claims recovery after acting)
descriptions.no_loop: agent minus the hypothesis loop (one iteration only)
descriptions.no_safety: agent minus the safety layer (no allowlist/ordering/rollback)
